title: What to do if your wallet is lost or stolen
desc: Prevent identity theft and credit card fraud in five quick steps.
todos: Call every card issuer immediately to freeze or cancel debit and credit cards and request replacements.
Contact one of the three major credit bureaus (Experian, TransUnion, Equifax) to place a free fraud alert on your credit file.
Report the missing drivers license or state ID to your local Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV).
File a non-emergency police report to create an official paper trail against identity theft.
List all missing contents (insurance cards, memberships, transit passes) and initiate replacement requests.
